_instructions: Score every hint for the pair it sits under. 'already_served' is context only: do not score it.

hints.explanation: Michael Jordan was nicknamed Air Jordan for his hang time on the basketball court.

lines.AIR: Air Jordan is his nickname and his sneaker line.
lines.BASKETBALL: Michael Jordan is a basketball legend.

hints.explanation: In Snow White, the queen disguised as an old witch gives her a poisoned apple.

lines.APPLE: Snow White bites the witch's apple.
lines.POISON: The witch's apple is laced with poison.

hints.explanation: Your spine runs down your back, and a book's spine holds its pages together.

lines.BACK: The spine runs along your back.
lines.BOOK: A book's spine shows its title on the shelf.

hints.explanation: The yellow Minions are obsessed with bananas, and a minion is a lowly helper who serves a boss.

lines.BANANA: In Despicable Me the Minions go wild for bananas.
lines.BOSS: A minion is a follower who does the boss's bidding.

hints.explanation: Cheers was the classic sitcom set in a Boston bar, and people say cheers when they raise a toast.

lines.BAR: Cheers is the sitcom set in a bar where everybody knows your name.
lines.TOAST: People say cheers when making a toast.

hints.explanation: Water goes down the sink drain, and in basketball slang to drain a shot is to sink it.

lines.BASKETBALL: Basketball players drain shots from long range.
lines.SINK: A sink empties through its drain.

hints.explanation: The asteroid belt lies between Mars and Jupiter, and an asteroid impact is the leading explanation for the dinosaurs' extinction.

lines.BELT: Most asteroids orbit in the asteroid belt.
lines.DINOSAUR: An asteroid strike helped wipe out the dinosaurs 66 million years ago.

hints.explanation: Jack Frost is said to nip at your nose in winter, and a nip is a small bite.

lines.BITE: A nip is a quick little bite.
lines.FROST: Jack Frost nips at noses on cold days.

hints.explanation: Tug-of-war is played with a rope, and a tugboat pulls big ships into port.

lines.BOAT: Tugboats tow ships in and out of harbor.
lines.ROPE: In tug-of-war two teams pull a rope.

hints.explanation: In myth Pandora opened the box that released the world's troubles, and Pandora is the jewelry brand famous for bracelet charms.

lines.BOX: Pandora's box let all the evils into the world.
lines.CHARM: Pandora bracelets are built from collectible charms.

hints.explanation: Shutters cover a window, and a camera's shutter opens to take a photo.

lines.CAMERA: A camera clicks when its shutter opens and closes.
lines.WINDOW: Window shutters block light and storms.

hints.explanation: Yankee Doodle stuck a feather in his cap, and the Yankees are New York's famous baseball team.

lines.CAP: "Yankee Doodle went to town... stuck a feather in his cap."
lines.NEW YORK: The New York Yankees are baseball's most famous team.

hints.explanation: Goldilocks breaks Baby Bear's little chair, and the "Goldilocks zone" is the not-too-hot, not-too-cold region where a planet could hold liquid water.

lines.CHAIR: Goldilocks sits in Baby Bear's chair and breaks it.
lines.PLANET: Astronomers search the Goldilocks zone for life-friendly planets.

hints.explanation: To mold something is to shape it, and blue cheese gets its veins from mold.

lines.CHEESE: Blue cheese is made with mold on purpose.
lines.SHAPE: You can mold clay into any shape.

hints.explanation: Skin is the body's largest organ, and a pipe organ fills a church with music.

lines.CHURCH: Many churches have a big pipe organ.
lines.SKIN: Skin is the largest organ of the human body.

hints.explanation: An hourglass is an old clock that tells time with falling sand.

lines.CLOCK: An hourglass is a simple sand clock.

hints.explanation: A comic strip is drawn in panels, and a group of judges is also called a panel.

lines.COMIC: Each box in a comic strip is a panel.
lines.JUDGE: Talent shows and courts can have a panel of judges.

hints.explanation: Dolly Parton is a country music legend, and Dolly was the famous cloned sheep.

lines.COUNTRY: Dolly Parton is a country music star.
lines.SHEEP: Dolly the sheep was the first mammal cloned from an adult cell.

hints.explanation: Pinocchio sings "I've Got No Strings," and Jiminy Cricket acts as his conscience.

lines.STRING: The wooden puppet boasts he has no strings to hold him down.

hints.explanation: You shuffle a deck of cards, and shuffle mode plays your songs in random order.

lines.DECK: Shuffling mixes a deck of cards.
lines.SONG: Shuffle plays your songs in a random order.

hints.explanation: A genius is brilliant, and a brilliant is a sparkling style of diamond cut.

lines.DIAMOND: The round brilliant is the classic diamond cut.
lines.GENIUS: A genius has a brilliant mind.

hints.explanation: Goose down fills pillows and jackets, and "Duck, Duck, Goose" is the playground circle game.

lines.DOWN: Goose down is a famously warm, soft feather filling.
lines.DUCK: In Duck, Duck, Goose, the picker taps heads saying "duck" until shouting "goose!"

hints.explanation: An eagle is a bird, and in golf an eagle beats a birdie by one stroke.

lines.EAGLE: An eagle is two under par, one better than a birdie.
lines.GOLF: A birdie is one under par in golf.

hints.explanation: Spotted Dalmatians are the famous firehouse dogs that ride on fire engines.

lines.ENGINE: Dalmatians are the traditional mascots of fire engines.
lines.SPOT: Dalmatians are known for their black spots.

hints.explanation: Fans in a packed stadium stand up in turn to make the wave.

lines.WAVE: Crowds do the wave around a stadium.

hints.explanation: Movies used to come on film reels, and a fishing rod has a reel to wind in the line.

lines.FILM: A film reel holds a movie.
lines.FISHING: A fishing reel winds the line in.

hints.explanation: France gave the United States the Statue of Liberty.

lines.FRANCE: The Statue of Liberty was a gift from France.
lines.STATUE: Lady Liberty is the famous statue in New York Harbor.

hints.explanation: David Bowie's Space Oddity opens with "Ground Control to Major Tom."

lines.GROUND: Ground Control is the mission control voice in the song.
lines.MAJOR: Major Tom is the astronaut drifting into space.

hints.explanation: A stiletto is a thin, high heel, and also a slim dagger.

lines.HEEL: Stilettos are shoes with tall, thin heels.
lines.KNIFE: A stiletto is a narrow-bladed knife.

hints.explanation: Tony Stark is Iron Man, and the Starks of Game of Thrones warn that winter is coming.

lines.WINTER: The Starks' motto is Winter Is Coming.

hints.explanation: A bank vault is a giant safe, and to vault is to jump, as in the pole vault.

lines.JUMP: Pole vaulters jump over a high bar using a pole.
lines.SAFE: A vault is a walk-in safe for valuables.

hints.explanation: Every magnet has a north and a south pole, and Santa lives at the North Pole.

lines.SANTA: Santa's home is the North Pole.

hints.explanation: Do-re-mi is a major scale, and a major is a military officer's rank.

lines.MILITARY: Major is an officer rank in the military.
lines.SCALE: Major and minor are the two main kinds of musical scale.

hints.explanation: A hammer is meant to hit the nail, but a missed swing can hit your thumb instead.

lines.NAIL: A hammer drives nails into wood.
lines.THUMB: A missed hammer swing on your thumb is a classic cartoon ouch.

hints.explanation: The Louvre in Paris has a glass pyramid entrance and the most famous painting in the world, the Mona Lisa.

lines.PAINTING: The Mona Lisa hangs in the Louvre.
lines.PYRAMID: The Louvre's glass pyramid is its iconic entrance.

hints.explanation: Pink Floyd's famous rock album is The Wall.

lines.PINK: Pink Floyd is the band's full name.
lines.WALL: "Another Brick in the Wall" is from The Wall.

hints.explanation: Punch is the classic seaside puppet of Punch and Judy, and a sock pulled over your hand makes a sock puppet.

lines.PUNCH: Punch and Judy is a traditional puppet show.
lines.SOCK: A sock puppet is the simplest homemade puppet.

hints.explanation: A computer monitor is a screen, and a monitor lizard is a large reptile.

lines.REPTILE: Monitor lizards, like the Komodo dragon, are reptiles.
lines.SCREEN: A monitor is a computer screen.

hints.explanation: A comet has a glowing tail, and Comet is one of Santa's reindeer.

lines.SANTA: Comet pulls Santa's sleigh with Dasher and Dancer.
lines.TAIL: Comets grow bright tails near the Sun.

hints.explanation: Hamlet holds up Yorick's skull ("Alas, poor Yorick!"), and a hamlet is a tiny town.

lines.SKULL: Hamlet's graveyard speech is delivered to a skull.
lines.TOWN: A hamlet is a small village.

hints.explanation: Captain America: The Winter Soldier is a Marvel film, and a captain is a military officer.

lines.WINTER: The Winter Soldier faces Captain America.

hints.explanation: Spades are a suit in a deck of cards, and a spade is a digging tool.

lines.SUIT: Spades is one of the four card suits.
lines.TOOL: A spade is a garden tool like a shovel.

hints.explanation: A pick is a digging tool, and a toothpick cleans between your teeth.

lines.TOOL: A pick is a classic digging tool.
lines.TOOTH: A toothpick is a little pick for your teeth.
